introduction:
Improve your English vocabulary and listening in just six minutes!
Many people choose to, or have to

vocabulary.definition: to work for yourself, selling your skills or services to different businesses
vocabulary.example: She decided to freelance as a graphic designer after leaving her full-time job.

vocabulary.definition: extremely frightening, causing one to freeze with fear
vocabulary.example: The thought of skydiving was petrifying for him.

vocabulary.definition: the act of undermining your own success or progress due to doubts and fears
vocabulary.example: Her tendency towards self-sabotage often held her back from taking on new challenges.

vocabulary.definition: the sense of satisfaction and happiness derived from achieving one's goals or desires
vocabulary.example: Helping others brought her a deep sense of fulfilment.

vocabulary.definition: the ability to control and make decisions about one's own finances without external restrictions
vocabulary.example: Winning the lottery provided him with the financial freedom to pursue his dreams.

vocabulary.definition: able to move quickly and easily; nimble
vocabulary.example: In today's fast-paced business environment, companies need to be agile to adapt to changes swiftly.
